name: cfa-research
description: Skills for university teams competing in the CFA Institute Research Challenge (LatAm).

plugins.name: research-challenge
plugins.description: From filings to a valued model: setup, thesis and industry coaching, financials, forecast, Excel model and valuation, risks and ESG, the written report, the pitch and the PowerPoint deck. The assistant does the technical work; the team owns the story.

plugins.name: research-analyst
plugins.description: Equity research coverage toolkit from CFA Society Mexico - AI for Finance (MIT): coverage folders, accounting profile, industry analysis, driver inventory, 3-statement model standards, deterministic valuation, materiality triage.
